questions.title: Questions about anchoring
questions.description: What happens to an anchored NFT, and what releasing it means.

whatIsAnchoring.question: What is anchoring?
whatIsAnchoring.answer: Anchoring places your NFTs with the protocol’s anchoring contracts. Anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs receive ETH Anchor Distributions, and anchored Random Walk NFTs enter the Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection. You can release an anchor at any time to get your NFTs back; releasing a Cosmic Signature NFT also retrieves the ETH it has accrued. Each NFT can be anchored only once: after a release, it can never be anchored again.

cosmicSignature.question: How does Cosmic Signature NFT anchoring work?
cosmicSignature.answer: Anchor your Cosmic Signature NFTs to receive ETH from the Anchor Distribution pool. Each cycle, {percentage}% of the Cycle Reserve is shared among all Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders in proportion to how many NFTs each has anchored. Distributions accumulate on their own and are retrieved when you release an anchor. If no Cosmic Signature NFT is anchored when a cycle finalizes, that cycle’s share stays in the Cycle Reserve.

randomWalk.question: How does Random Walk NFT anchoring work?
randomWalk.answer: Anchor your Random Walk NFTs to take part in the Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection. Each cycle it picks {selections} of the anchored Random Walk NFTs at random on-chain, and every pick gives that NFT’s anchor-holder {cst, number} CST and one newly imprinted Cosmic Signature NFT. The same NFT can be picked more than once in a cycle. Random Walk anchors receive no ETH.

calculation.question: How are distributions calculated?
calculation.answer: Cosmic Signature NFT Anchor Distributions are proportional: if you have anchored one tenth of all anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs, you receive one tenth of each ETH Anchor Distribution deposit. Random Walk NFTs take part in the Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection instead, so anchoring more of them makes it more likely that one of yours is picked; it does not give you an ETH share.

anchorOnce.question: Can I anchor an NFT again after releasing it?
anchorOnce.answer: No. The anchoring contracts record every NFT that has ever been anchored, and each NFT can be anchored only once. Releasing an anchor returns the NFT to your wallet and, for a Cosmic Signature NFT, retrieves the ETH it has accrued, but it ends that NFT’s anchoring for good. Release only when you are done anchoring that NFT.
